title: ANSI E1.21 — 2024 Entertainment Technology — Temporary Structures Used for Technical Production of Outdoor Entertainment Events
jurisdiction_scope: voluntary consensus standard unless adopted/required by contract, venue, code or authority
model_product_scope: temporary ground-supported structures used for technical production of outdoor entertainment events
notes: Current scope/version identified from ESTA published-documents index. It does not apply automatically to every indoor modular deck or platform system.

title: ANSI E1.2 — 2021 Entertainment Technology — Design, Manufacture and Use of Aluminum Trusses and Towers
jurisdiction_scope: voluntary consensus standard unless adopted/required by contract, venue, code or authority
model_product_scope: aluminum trusses, towers and associated aluminum structural components
notes: Useful as evidence that entertainment structural systems have distinct scope-specific standards. Not a modular-deck assembly manual.

title: 29 CFR 1910.22 — General requirements for walking-working surfaces
jurisdiction_scope: US federal general industry where Subpart D applies
role_scope: employers and employees using covered walking-working surfaces
notes: Supports general walking-working-surface condition/inspection obligations where applicable. It does not provide structural design, platform assembly or load-acceptance authority.
